name: Ollama
title: Ollama: run open AI models on your own laptop
caption:
Kit asked Claude how to run AI on a laptop, offline. The answer: Ollama 🦙

✅ One command to install, then: ollama run gemma4
✅ Open models like Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek and gpt-oss
✅ A local REST API on localhost:11434 for your own apps
✅ ollama launch claude starts Claude Code with it

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Bigger models need a lot of RAM (or a good GPU) to run well, and Ollama also offers optional cloud models

Comment "LOCAL" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for open-source finds for developers

#ollama #localai #llm #developer #opensource #github #ai

thumb.line: run open models on your laptop

beats.speaker: kit
beats.say: Claude, can I run an AI model on my own laptop? Offline?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.say: You can. It's called Ollama, and it's free and open source.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.say: Install it, then type ollama run, and the name of a model.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.say: Open ones, like Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.say: It also runs a local API, so your own apps can talk to it.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.say: Wait. Can it launch you, too?

beats.speaker: kit
beats.say: Comment Local, and I'll send you the link.
